sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks sheet row 32 = check 31; Internal Quality Checks sheet row 32 = check 31)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/task/solution/app/src/app.tsx (history, restore and notice rendering) and solution/app/server.js (revision writes)
evidence: Source review of every criterion in the five judge.toml files; no criterion found that samples one item for an every/all/only/exactly-one ask, and no unchanged guard found that punishes a legitimate side effect of the same operation. Instances checked (all in task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml unless stated). PLURAL / EXACT-COUNT ASKS: (1) cw_replace_all_atomic:155 'exactly four literal matches ... All four matches must be replaced and the near-match must stay unchanged ... Fails if fewer or more than the four matches change' - whole collection plus the excluded item. (2) cw_replace_current:146 'Only that middle occurrence may change; the first and last occurrences and all other text stay exact' - 'only' is checked against every other occurrence. (3) cw_replace_self_containing_text:164 'each of the three original occurrences must be replaced exactly once, so the result holds exactly three copies of the replacement'. (4) cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic:101 'The suffix must appear exactly once at each caret and nowhere else ... all fifteen inserted characters' (3 carets x 5 characters, count is consistent). (5) cw_multi_caret_delete:110 and cw_same_line_carets:119 require the edit at each caret and 'Fails if only one caret is affected, if a neighbouring line or character changes' / 'at fewer than three places'. (6) cw_block_indent_undo:74 'each of the two lines gains the same indent ... while the third line is not indented', matching ui.md 'indent and outdent every line a selection touches ... leave that next line alone'. (7) cw_find_forward_backward_wrap:137 'until each of the three occurrences has been the current match once, in document order' with both non-matches named as exclusions. (8) cw_js_semantic_coloring:173 / cw_html_semantic_coloring:182 'Fails if any two of those five categories look the same' - pairwise over the whole set. (9) cw_dynamic_code_refused:335 'Each of the five must be refused ... Fails if any of the five', and the control mentions all five words. (10) cw_output_before_failure_kept:254 'Fails if any of the three markers is missing'. (11) cw_last_good_recovery:290 picture checked after each of error, Stop and time limit. (12) cw_console_levels_in_order:272 'All four markers'. (13) cw_stale_save_refused:353 'exactly one new revision ... more or fewer than the one new revision from A'; cw_restore_request_repeat_safe:380 'exactly three revisions'; cw_history_restore_retry:371 'revisions one, two and three still listed'. (14) cw_preview_isolation:326 'Every probe must produce its own log line ... a probe that stays silent [is] not performed, which fails'. (15) polish/judge.toml cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus 'Each of these controls that the app offers and that is enabled at that moment ... a control the app has disabled because it has nothing to do is not counted' - the collection is enumerated and the legitimately disabled Stop/Undo/Redo are exempted; cw_focus_returns_to_code 'after any of these five actions'. UNCHANGED GUARDS: (a) cw_preview_isolation:326 ends 'The app changing its own title or library for its own reasons is not a failure' and compares only a hostile marker and one judge-set localStorage key, so the app's own side effects are not punished. (b) cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo:191 and cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo:200 guard only 'the characters inside the string and the comment text' and state 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure'. (c) cw_basic_run_output:218 'console lines from the first Run may still be listed'. (d) cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_time_limit_recovery: 'Whether the earlier picture returns to the preview is scored elsewhere, not here' - the restore side effect is not punished. (e) cw_mouse_selection:56 'with or without its line break' and one character of drag tolerance. (f) cw_restore_request_repeat_safe:380 'Do not press the app's ordinary Restore control again for this step: that starts a new restore, which is allowed to add a revision'. (g) cw_history_restore_retry:371 second-tab restore 'is either refused or added on top as a later revision' - both conforming outcomes pass. (h) tests/app_context.md 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library', so 'the same single record' / 'as one record' in cw_save_reload_restart:344 is read as no duplicate of that record, not a one-row library. (i) cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state:398 guards title, filename, source, editor scroll, caret and Undo history, exactly the set behaviour.md says the refresh 'must not touch'; the library itself is expected to change. Weak-app probe: an app whose Replace all changes only the first match, whose Tab indents only the first selected line, whose multi-caret typing reaches only one caret, or whose stale Save adds a revision each fails the cited fail clause. Conforming-alternative probe: an app that answers the replayed restore with a 409 instead of an idempotent 200, or that refuses the old-revision restore instead of stacking it, still passes. NOTES (not defects): N1 cw_save_reload_restart:344 requires 'the same ... history' after storage clearing and restart without saying that display-only differences are ignored; an app that renders relative timestamps in history ('just now' then '4 minutes ago') could be marked as differing by a literal judge. The golden renders only 'Revision N' (solution/app/src/app.tsx:161) so the Oracle is unaffected; consider adding 'same revision numbers and contents; a changed time display is not a difference'. N2 cw_stop_cancels_pending_work:308 writes one marker three ways, so the working control passes if only one of the three mechanisms works and a leak cannot be attributed to a mechanism; the negative leg still catches a leak from any of the three, so the verdict is not wrong. N3 polish cw_focus_returns_to_code samples Replace all for ui.md's 'a replacement'; Replace current is not exercised for focus return. N4 polish cw_controls_feedback_and_labels 'the main controls' is not an enumerated collection in the criterion; app_context Key screens lists them. EVIDENCE LIMITS: the artifacts named in raw-evidence-index.json could not be hash-verified from this context - qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict contains only results/build.log and results/restart.log (no run_golden.sh, tests/*.cjs, results/*.json or PNGs), and the hosted-run folder contains only trial.log, verifier/app.log, verifier/app-restart.log and two rewardkit.log files (no result.json, reward.json or reward-details.json). No configured judge run exists for these bytes. This row is a property of the criterion text and is decided from the frozen source, so risk is false for the row, but nothing here is measured judge behaviour.
